newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis Q1 sales rise six percent.
newsitem.headline: Publicis Q1 sales rise six percent.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)
Media and space selling 542, down 4 pct
NOTE - Publicis gave the figures in a statement. It said turnover was five percent higher in the period at constant structure. The rise was due largely to international development.
It said 60 percent of turnover in its communication division was made outside France in the period.

The division's result includes the sale of MC&C Messeagentur, which had turnover of 61 million francs in the first quarter of 1996, and the expectetd sales of FCB Paris, FCB Lisbon and FCB UK to True North Communication. These sales will become effective once definitive accords are signed with True North.

It also includes turnover of recently-acquired companies Publicis Norton in Brazil, BCP in Canada, Publicis Romero in Mexico, Publicis Basic in the Philippines and Publicis Eureka in Singapore, which amounts to 349 million francs.

Publicis said it has won advertising accounts from Hermes, Vedior, Puiforcat, Arcopal, Galeries Lafayette and Tefal in France, the Spanish national lottery, Spanish Railways and the Spanish Parliament's institutional communication, Swiss telecommunications, Seagram in Canada and the Mexican yoghurt industry since the beginning of the year .
